title: Forty Years of Watching the Wrong Number

beats.say: For forty years, investors sat on conference calls and cheered: great quarter, Wal-Mart.

scene.head: THE WRONG NUMBER
scene.src: Nomad letter, period ended 30 Jun 2009 · p.162

beats.say: But Sleep says they incorrectly weighed the information. They leaned on valuation, margin trends and revenue growth.

scene.head: WEIGHED WRONG

beats.say: The real engine was simpler: a thrift orientation, fueling growth, with the savings shared with the customer.
